headline: China Open Final: Djokovic captures 7th Beijing title as De Minaur retires
whyCareReason: Djokovic wins his 7th China Open and 102nd career ATP title; De Minaur forced to retire with a groin injury in the second set.
teaser: Djokovic claims 33rd career win in Beijing (7-6, 0-1 ret.) to lift trophy before heading to Shanghai.
story: Novak Djokovic captured his seventh China Open title on Tuesday when Alex de Minaur was forced to retire with a groin strain trailing 7-6(3), 0-1 at Beijing's National Tennis Center. The victory extends Djokovic's spotless career record in Beijing to 33-0 and delivers his 102nd career ATP singles trophy. Simultaneously at the Japan Open in Tokyo, Carlos Alcaraz defended his title with a 7-6(4), 6-4 win over Jiri Lehecka, recording his 10th consecutive match victory. Both champions now head to the Rolex Shanghai Masters where main-draw play begins Wednesday.
stakes: ATP 500 trophy, 500 ranking points, and pristine Beijing record.
rivalryAngle: Djokovic maintains unbeaten record in Beijing finals.
